name: IC 3652 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 3652, a dwarf elliptical galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ic3652-hubble
story: A small dwarf galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, with a distinct nucleus at its center. Hubble imaged it as one of 100 early-type galaxies in the ACS Virgo Cluster Survey.

claims.text: VCC 1861 is IC 3652, type dE0,N, one of the ACS Virgo Cluster Survey targets
The ACS Virgo Cluster Survey imaged 100 early-type galaxies in the Virgo Cluster with Hubble
VCC 1861 is a nucleated early-type dwarf (dwarf elliptical) galaxy in the Virgo Cluster
